name: 오팔 앵무조개
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: A NAUTILUS with cream spiral chambered shell, warm tan stripes and subtle opal iridescence around shell opening, many short fine cream tentacles beneath opening, natural visible eye. Front three-quarter view. Front or top three-quarter view, upright, same orientation throughout. Maintain cute cartoon foundation.  OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle body gently contracting and relaxing, fins and arms folding then opening phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
padding_fix_prompt: Fix ONLY the layout of this 2x2 animation sprite sheet. Preserve exact cartoon character identity, colors, outline and the four subtle animation poses. Each animal is currently too large and crosses equal-cell boundaries. Recreate the sheet with SMALLER animals and LOTS of transparent space. Canvas is square. Four equal cells, centers precisely at (25%,25%),(75%,25%),(25%,75%),(75%,75%). The full bounding box INCLUDING fins, arms, antennae, shell and tail for EACH animal must be NO LARGER THAN 30% of TOTAL canvas width and 30% of TOTAL height (=60% of its cell). Keep same scale for four animals. Outer 8% border completely transparent; central vertical band x=43%..57% and horizontal band y=43%..57% completely transparent. Do not add visible gridlines. Actual alpha transparent background. No scenery, text, labels, bubbles or shadow. Do not enlarge the animals to fill the sheet. Four SMALL complete animals with broad blank gaps, important for game frame slicing.
